blocks.label: NORTHBANK MOBILITY LAB  /  FIELD REPORT
blocks.lead: From May to August 2026, Northbank Mobility Lab observed three walking routes and mapped opportunities for shade and free seating.

illustration.alt: Two pedestrians walk beneath teal canopies on a fictional waterfront path.
illustration.caption: A canopy over a fictional waterfront path. Concept illustration.

blocks.text: The study identified 18 candidate shade sites on 2.4 km of priority links. It assessed placement opportunities. Temperature reductions were outside its measurements.
Start with temporary shade and free seating at Junction, East Arcade and River Steps. Keep a clear walking line beside each proposed seating area.
Walk each priority link at midday. Record shaded seating and step-free access. Repeat the same check after installing the temporary elements.
